select.observation: Bundled-font native probe renders paragraph and following button, but select and its options are absent. Pinned form.rs has unimplemented select extraction; event adapter has no select input path. Capability stays rejected; finite choices use ordinary buttons.

keyboardTransport.observation: cua pressKey(Tab) timed out after 10 seconds on focused X11 probe; source adapter gaps will be implemented and tested separately. No real-keyboard verification claim.

captureCalibration.observation: Both exact browser canvas calibration patterns survive T3 snapshot byte-for-byte at scale 1; no capture blur defect demonstrated.

scope: Initial Phase1 probes, retained unchanged observations; current DOM calibration and native input results supersede narrower initial checks.
